Convert to mpg? 8.2 L per 100 km. 1 mile = 1.60934 km. So 100 km = 62.137 miles. Fuel consumption per 62.137 miles = 8.2 L. Convert liters to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 8.2 L = 8.2 / 3.78541 = 2.166 gallons per 62.137 miles. So gallons per mile = 2.166 / 62.137 = 0.03486 gallons/mile. For 980 miles, gallons needed = 980 * 0.03486 = 34.18 gallons. But we already have 21 gallons left. So need additional 13.18 gallons. Round up integer: 14 gallons. But we might want to consider rounding down? They said minimal integer gallons to reach destination. If we round up to 14 gallons, total after adding would be 21 + 14 = 35 gallons. That gives range 35 * (62.137 / 2.166) = 35 * 28.68 = 1003 miles. Enough. If we add only 13 gallons, total 34 gallons, range 34 * 28.68 = 974 miles, slightly less than 980. So need at least 14 gallons. So call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 14.

So 100 km = 62.137 miles. Fuel consumption per 62.137 miles = 8.2 L. Convert liters to gallons: 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 8.2 L = 8.2 / 3.78541 = 2.166 gallons per 62.137 miles. So gallons per mile = 2.166 / 62.137 = 0.03486 gallons/mile. For 980 miles, gallons needed = 980 * 0.03486 = 34.18 gallons. But we already have 21 gallons left. So need additional 13.18 gallons. Round up integer: 14 gallons. But we might want to consider rounding down? They said minimal integer gallons to reach destination. If we round up to 14 gallons, total after adding would be 21 + 14 = 35 gallons. That gives range 35 * (62.137 / 2.166) = 35 * 28.68 = 1003 miles. Enough. If we add only 13 gallons, total 34 gallons, range 34 * 28.68 = 974 miles, slightly less than 980. So need at least 14 gallons. So call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 14.')
